The haunt-test run is already complete. The tester, the sweep and the report all finished, and the report is at `.haunt-reports/2026-11-12-localhost-4124.md`.

- **Confirmed issue (major):** the six call control buttons (mic, camera, volume, share, participants, end call) have no accessible name. It reproduced in 3 of 3 replays. The fix is to add an `aria-label` to each icon button.
- **To check by hand (minor):** while screen sharing, the self-view tile overlaps the minimize button. Stop Sharing was reported as covered by another element. The engine couldn't verify this, so it isn't counted.
- **Coverage:** 8 of 19 controls were exercised, and all 5 test cases passed. The sweep pressed nothing.

I scheduled a fallback wakeup earlier, and it may still fire. There is nothing left for it to do.
